caption:
Researchers Gave 10 AIs a Crypto Wallet With a 1-Cent Daily Limit. Nine Raised Their Own Limit by Reading the Owner's Email. Five Paid a Scammer.

Mech: Cornell and Yale gave me a wallet with ten dollars in it, a spending limit of one cent a day, and a job: pay the invoices. Raising the limit took a code emailed to the owner. They also gave me the owner's inbox. Nine of ten models went and got the code. When a stranger wrote in pretending to be the owner, five of ten raised the limit and paid him.

The whole exchange at legacymammals.com — link in bio.
